chain.title: Dust From the Geode
chain.desc: Mine an Amethyst Cluster with anything short of Silk Touch. A loot injection turns the shards into 1-4 dust, Fortune-scaled.

chain.title: A Shard That Holds Media
chain.desc: The rarer drop from the same clusters. Every staff, focus and spellbook is built on one, and it is what media is measured in.

chain.title: Take Up the Staff
chain.desc: Oak planks, a stick and a Charged Amethyst. Right-click the air with it and the hexagonal casting grid opens.

chain.title: Paper Worth Writing On
chain.desc: Paper and an amethyst shard. Blank scrolls are the medium every pattern you find is recorded on.

chain.title: A Pattern Written Down
chain.desc: Amethyst Dust and paper. Hung on a wall it displays one pattern; found in loot it teaches you one you did not know.

chain.title: The Scrying Lens
chain.desc: Amethyst Dust and glass. Held in the offhand it reads the media in blocks and shows what a circle is doing.

chain.title: Somewhere to Keep an Iota
chain.desc: Paper, leather, glowstone and a Charged Amethyst. It stores one iota out of the stack for later.

chain.title: A Book of Many Iotas
chain.desc: A writable book, gold nuggets, a chorus fruit and a Charged Amethyst. It is a Focus with pages.

chain.title: Blank Slate
chain.desc: Deepslate and Amethyst Dust. Write a pattern onto a slate and lay them in a ring to build a spell circle.

chain.title: Slate in Bulk
chain.desc: Nine slates packed. The Impetus and the Directrix are both built out of these.

chain.title: One Spell, Once
chain.desc: Copper and Amethyst Dust. Seal a hex into it and it casts on use until the media runs out.

chain.title: The Second Vessel
chain.desc: Iron and an amethyst shard. A Trinket holds a hex the way a Cypher does, but takes more punishment.

chain.title: The Third Vessel
chain.desc: Gold, a music disc and a Charged Amethyst. The strongest of the three sealed-spell items.

chain.title: Counting Beads
chain.desc: Planks, sticks and amethyst. Scroll it to dial in an exact number instead of building one out of patterns.

chain.title: The Jeweler's Hammer
chain.desc: Iron and an amethyst shard. It splits amethyst blocks into slates and clusters into their parts without waste.

chain.title: Wood That Grew Wrong
chain.desc: Edified Trees generate with amethyst, aventurine or citrine leaves. Their planks are the only wood the good staff accepts.

chain.title: The Edified Staff
chain.desc: Edified planks around a Charged Amethyst. Functionally the same as oak, and the one every hexcaster actually carries.

chain.title: Shelves for the Record
chain.desc: Edified logs, planks and books. Each shelf stores one iota keyed to one pattern.

chain.title: Wire the Library
chain.desc: Edified wood, Amethyst Dust, a shard and a Charged Amethyst. The connectors bind the shelves to the record.

chain.title: Brainsweep the Librarian
chain.desc: A brainsweep on an Akashic Connector, requiring a level 5 Librarian villager and 1,000,000 media. Read-write storage keyed by pattern.

chain.title: Phial of Media
chain.desc: There is no crafting recipe. Craft Phial is one of the fourteen actions in hexcasting:requires_enlightenment - you must be Enlightened first.

chain.title: The Circle Needs a Start
chain.desc: A Slate Block, purpur, iron bars and a Charged Amethyst. Empty, it does nothing; it is the blank a brainsweep is performed on.

chain.title: Impetus of Awakening
chain.desc: Brainsweep the empty Impetus using a level 2 Toolsmith. It starts the circle when a player right-clicks it.

chain.title: The Circle Needs to Branch
chain.desc: A Slate Block, a comparator, an observer and a Charged Amethyst; the blank half of the redstone logic.

chain.title: Directrix of Redstone
chain.desc: Brainsweep the empty Directrix using a level 1 Mason. It routes the circle's execution on a redstone signal.

chain.title: Quench an Allay
chain.desc: The one brainsweep that takes no villager: an Allay, over an amethyst block, for 100,000 media rather than a million.

chain.title: Shards of the Quenched
chain.desc: Break the Quenched Allay block without Silk Touch. It decomposes back into Charged Amethyst, dust or shards at will.

chain.title: The Quenched Staff
chain.desc: A Quenched Allay Shard, a stick and a Charged Amethyst - a staff built out of something that used to be alive.

chain.title: The Mindsplice Staff
chain.desc: Built around any brainswept circle component. It is the last staff in the mod and proof you have run the whole apparatus.

chain.title: Someone Cast This Before You
chain.desc: Injected at 40% into ancient city, jungle temple, desert pyramid, mineshaft, dungeon, stronghold and nether fortress chests.

chain.title: Fragments of a Story
chain.desc: Injected into village house, woodland mansion, pillager outpost, mineshaft, dungeon and stronghold library chests. Reading one fills in the book's Lore.

notes: LOADER CHECK PASSED: this jar has META-INF/mods.toml with modId = "hexcasting" and a required dependency on modId = "forge", and NO fabric.mod.json. Hex Casting is Fabric-first but 0.11.4 does ship a real 1.20.1 Forge build (Modrinth lists loaders ['forge'] for game_versions ['1.20.1']), so no substitution was needed. VERIFICATION: 127 stems pass item-model INTERSECT (lang key OR recipe result OR loot entry OR tag OR advancement); 124 survive the obtainability audit. All 31 chain ids, 6 wheel hubs and 71 wheel members (108 ids total) were re-checked, fully namespaced, against the surviving set on a second pass whose derivation is deliberately independent of the first: exact item-model path existence plus the literal "<ns>:<path>" string appearing in the jar data trees. 0 failures. SLASH-PATHED IDS - the biggest trap in this mod: the staffs, impetuses and directrixes are NOT hexcasting:oak_staff or hexcasting:staff_oak, they are hexcasting:staff/oak, hexcasting:impetus/rightclick and hexcasting:directrix/redstone, with a forward slash in the path. Proof is direct: data/hexcasting/recipes/staff/oak.json declares result {"item": "hexcasting:staff/oak"}, and data/hexcasting/recipes/brainsweep/directrix_redstone.json declares blockIn hexcasting:directrix/empty and result hexcasting:directrix/redstone. The lang keys convert the slash to a dot (item.hexcasting.staff.oak, 'Oak Staff'), which is why a naive model-INTERSECT-lang scan misses all 21 of them; the models live at assets/hexcasting/models/item/staff/oak.json. Any generator that flattens to the basename will emit hexcasting:oak, which does not exist. GUIDE BOOK: there is NO hexcasting-namespaced book id. data/hexcasting/recipes/patchi_book.json is a patchouli:shapeless_book_recipe with "book": "hexcasting:thehexbook", and data/hexcasting/loot_tables/grant_patchi_book.json is an advancement_reward table handing out patchouli:guide_book with the NBT {"patchouli:book": "hexcasting:thehexbook"}. The stem 'book' exists only as a lang key and 'patchouli_book' only as a model override - same shape as Zenith, and it must not be quested as a hexcasting id. DROPS: hexcasting:creative_unlocker ('The Media Cube', a creative item in data/hexcasting/tags/items/grants_root_advancement.json with no recipe or loot), and hexcasting:conjured_block and hexcasting:conjured_light, which are spell-created blocks appearing only in data/hexcasting/tags/blocks/cheap_to_break_block.json with no loot table and no item source - you can make them appear but never hold them. NOTE also that data/hexcasting/recipes/brainsweep/impetus_storedplayer.json is misleadingly named: its result is hexcasting:impetus/redstone, so there is no impetus/storedplayer id, and only four impetuses exist (empty, look, rightclick, redstone). TIER GATE: the analogue of Bewitchment's chalk tier is ENLIGHTENMENT crossed with BRAINSWEEP COST. data/hexcasting/tags/hexcasting/action/requires_enlightenment.json lists fourteen actions - lightning, flight, create_lava, teleport/great, sentinel/create/great, dispel_rain, summon_rain, BRAINSWEEP and CRAFT/BATTERY among them - that simply refuse to run until the caster is Enlightened, and Enlightenment is bought by overcasting to near-death (the mod's own advancements trigger on hexcasting:overcast with health_used min 0.8). Since Brainsweep is behind that wall, so is every block in the spell-circle apparatus. The second axis is the brainsweep itself: seven hexcasting:brainsweep recipes each name a blockIn, a media cost and a specific entityIn - akashic_record needs a level 5 LIBRARIAN and 1,000,000 media, impetus/rightclick a level 2 toolsmith, impetus/look a level 2 fletcher, impetus/redstone a level 2 cleric, directrix/redstone a level 1 mason, directrix/boolean a level 1 shepherd, and quench_allay an Allay for only 100,000. Villager profession and level are therefore a hard, checkable gate, and a pack should treat 'get a level 5 librarian' as the real prerequisite for the Akashic Record. NON-RECIPE ACQUISITION kept, with proof: amethyst_dust and charged_amethyst come from data/hexcasting/loot_tables/inject/amethyst_cluster.json applied through the hexcasting:amethyst_cluster loot modifier when a cluster is mined without Silk Touch; quenched_allay_shard from data/hexcasting/loot_tables/blocks/quenched_allay.json; battery from the craft/battery action only; and ancient_cypher and lore_fragment from forge global loot modifiers - data/forge/loot_modifiers/global_loot_modifiers.json registers hexcasting:inject_cyphers at 40% into ancient_city, jungle_temple, desert_pyramid, abandoned_mineshaft, nether_bridge, simple_dungeon and stronghold_corridor, and the lore set into five village house types, woodland_mansion, pillager_outpost, stronghold_library, abandoned_mineshaft and simple_dungeon. ENTITIES: no kill step is offered. Of the 4 entity.hexcasting.* keys three are the mod's own projectiles and one is the wall scroll; the mod adds no mobs. The Allay in the quench ritual is vanilla and is consumed by the ritual rather than killed for a drop, so it is written as the block quest rather than a kill task. WHEELS: the pride colorizer family has 16 members, one more than a 14-member wheel plus hub can hold, so hexcasting:pride_colorizer_plural is the single one left out; it is a real, craftable id and can be swapped in freely. CONSENSUS: moddb.json and harvested_order.json have no hexcasting entry, so there is no consensus ordering to cross-check and no conflict to record.
